name: us021-state-tasks-deleted
description: T021a [US2]: mirror of us021-state-tasks-appeared — tasks.md is present for the first reconcile and removed before the second. data-model.md §1 'inputs members': tasks.md's key is omitted entirely once the file is gone, so its disappearance changes the inputs map just as its appearance does; the second run must be a full reconcile, and the freshly recorded state's inputs must carry no tasks.md key.
